csv_project_name: CPM Services for Kane Spring Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The California Department of Water Resources, may be seeking a Consultant to provide Construction Project Management Services for Division of Engineering. The Contractor will provide construction management services for the Kane Spring Progressive Design-Build Project, including staffing for a Construction Manager, Construction Inspector, and Project Engineer. Services will also include cultural and environmental monitoring support during construction activities. Materials testing services may also be provided in coordination with Bryte Lab personnel, as required.
